pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — a great crowd packed together in the shade of dark woodland, the preacher standing bareheaded in a brown robe with his hands open before him, countrymen in cloaks and women in white headcloths pressing in from every side, and boys perched in the branches overhead to see over them, in those days john the baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of judea, and saying, repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_sermon_of_saint_john_the_baptist

pictures.scene: Church, Twilight in the Wilderness — an empty northern country at sunset, long bars of burning red and orange cloud streaming across the whole sky above black wooded ridges, and a still lake holding the same fire upside down between the dark hills, this is he who was spoken of through the prophet isaiah, a voice of one calling in the wilderness, prepare the way for the lord, make straight paths for him
pictures.name: pd_church_twilight_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Allston, Elijah in the Desert — a huge bleached dead tree standing alone on brown stony ground with a raven perched high on its broken limb, blue mountains far behind under heavy cloud, a second raven flying in low with food in its beak, and a small figure in a pale grey robe crouched at the lower right beside a dark pool, john wore a garment of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist, his food was locusts and wild honey
pictures.name: pd_allston_elijah_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Repin, A Religious Procession in Kursk Province — an enormous crowd moving across open dusty country under a hazy sky, tall gold banners and a jewelled shrine carried high at the back of it, a priest in a gold flowered vestment at the right, mounted police at the left edge, and a lame boy in a grey coat swinging himself forward on a crutch in the front of the dust, people went out to him from jerusalem and all judea and the whole region around the jordan, confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the jordan river
pictures.name: pd_repin_religious_procession_in_kursk_province

pictures.scene: Delen, The Pharisee and the Publican — a vast pale stone interior of tall columns and vaulted arches over a chequered blue and cream floor, a man in a dark red mantle standing out at the foot of a pillar with his face lifted and one hand raised as he speaks, and a second man far off at the right in a red cloak with his head bowed and both hands pressed to his breast, but when john saw many of the pharisees and sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, you brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath
pictures.name: pd_delen_pharisee_and_publican

pictures.scene: Pissarro, Orchard in Bloom at Louveciennes — one fruit tree covered in white blossom filling the whole picture against a blue sky of scattered cloud, a second tree leaning in at the right, bare brown tilled earth running away below them, and a worker in a blue smock stooping low at the left over a heap of cut branches, produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance, and do not presume to say to yourselves, we have abraham as our father, for i tell you that out of these stones god can raise up children for abraham
pictures.name: pd_pissarro_orchard_in_bloom_louveciennes

pictures.scene: Friedrich, The Abbey in the Oakwood — the broken shell of a gothic church standing in snow with one tall traceried window left open to the sky, great dead oaks with splintered trunks and bare twisted branches crowding round it, a thin crescent moon high in the grey light, and a line of small dark figures carrying a coffin in through the ruined doorway past an open grave, the axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire, i baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come one more powerful than i, whose sandals i am not worthy to carry
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_the_abbey_in_the_oakwood

pictures.scene: Millet, The Winnower — a labourer in a red cap and a loose white shirt braced forward in the half dark of a barn, a blue sash at his waist and his legs bare below the knee, shaking a shallow wicker basket of grain so that the chaff flies out in a cloud of gold where the light falls on the floor, he will baptize you with the holy spirit and with fire, his winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather his wheat into the barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_winnower

pictures.scene: West, Joshua Passing the River Jordan with the Ark of the Covenant — a wide column of white light breaking down out of the clouds and filling almost the whole sky, and below it at the water's edge the gold ark with its winged figures carried on long poles by priests in white turbans, a horseman and red and blue banners crowded behind them, and a bearded man in white throwing up both arms toward the light, at that time jesus came from galilee to the jordan to be baptized by john, but john tried to prevent him, saying, i need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me
pictures.name: pd_west_joshua_passing_the_river_jordan_with_the_ark

pictures.scene: Guercino, Christ at the Well — a bearded man with long dark hair in a red tunic and a deep blue mantle leaning on the stone rim of a well, his lips parted in the middle of speaking, one hand resting on the stone and the other open and turned out toward the person he is answering, let it be so now, jesus replied, it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way, then john permitted him
pictures.name: pd_guercino_christ_at_the_well

pictures.scene: Millais, The Return of the Dove to the Ark — two girls standing barefoot on loose straw in a dark wooden hold, one in a long deep green gown with her eyes closed, the other in white and violet bending her face down to kiss the white dove they are holding together against them, and a small green olive sprig between her fingers, as soon as jesus was baptized, he went up out of the water, suddenly the heavens were opened, and he saw the spirit of god descending like a dove and resting on him
pictures.name: pd_millais_the_return_of_the_dove_to_the_ark

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — a figure in pale blue seated on cloud inside a deep blue oval ringed with small cherub heads, a gold cross halo behind him and gold rays going out across the whole panel, one hand raised in blessing and the other open, haloed saints and angels standing close on either side with their hands joined, and a winged angel below holding up a tall thin cross, and a voice from heaven said, this is my beloved son, in whom i am well pleased
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

lines.text: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
and saying, Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah:
A voice of one calling in the wilderness, Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.
John wore a garment of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist.
His food was locusts and wild honey.
People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.
Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them,
You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.
And do not presume to say to yourselves, We have Abraham as our father. For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry.
He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn, but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
But John tried to prevent Him, saying, I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?
Let it be so now, Jesus replied.
It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way. Then John permitted Him.
As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water.
Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
And a voice from heaven said,
This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!
